status: Exploratory historical development; 1900–2010 results have previously been inspected. This specification precedes fitting this experiment, not all analysis of these data.
source: Annual machine-verified ProQuest economy exports, 1900–2010 only
panel: National claims in general_business, markets, prices, employment; all readable normalized directions, regardless of horizon or outcome eligibility; no deduplication of stripped labels
panel_weighting: Equal article within newspaper/topic/month, then equal newspaper within topic/month
forecast_origin: First day of month t; newspaper features end in t-1
target: Direction of INDPRO monthly average change from t-1 to t+5; six monthly-index intervals, evaluated retrospectively
label_maturity: Target endpoint plus three calendar months must be strictly before the annual refit origin. This does not reconstruct historical data vintages.
refit: Every January; expanding training data, no within-year refit
signal_coverage: Prior three complete months must include at least two observed months, two distinct newspapers, and five distinct articles. Otherwise all four signals are missing. Previous three months must satisfy the same rule for the change feature; changes average only newspapers represented in both windows.

signal_definitions.net_direction_3m: Mean of equal-paper monthly (positive share minus negative share) over observed months in t-3 through t-1
signal_definitions.net_change_common_papers: Equal-paper mean change in each common paper's observed-month net direction between t-6:t-4 and t-3:t-1; at least two common papers
signal_definitions.disagreement_3m: Mean normalized Gini impurity 1.5*(1-sum(direction shares squared)) of equal-paper monthly distributions in t-3:t-1
signal_definitions.paper_dispersion_3m: Mean population standard deviation of article-weighted paper net directions over months with at least two papers in t-3:t-1

models.coverage_only: Multinomial ridge logistic regression on four signal-missingness indicators
models.base_rate_plus_press: Multinomial ridge logistic regression with fitted intercepts, four standardized press signals and their four missingness indicators

imputation: Train-period medians only, zero fallback for entirely missing columns; missingness indicators always retained; standardization learned on training data only
class_weighting: None; each forecast month receives equal weight
tuning: None; no configuration chosen from evaluation results
primary_metric: Multiclass Brier score, sum of squared errors across three classes (range 0–2); lower is better
uncertainty: Paired resampling of forecast-year blocks, anchored at 1950, keeping all models' predictions together; 2000 draws each at 2, 5, and 10 years; intervals describe historical variability and condition on fitted forecasts
stability: Report four development blocks, every decade, and every five-year block; evaluate again omitting 2007–2009; leave each five-year block out of evaluation and report the range. These scoring exclusions do not refit models or remove the episode from later training histories.
coverage_sensitivity: Evaluate on the same subset with all four signals observed; no refit
limitations: Selected downturn/recovery query; unvalidated extraction; changing newspaper coverage; broad business proxy; revised outcome data and approximate label availability. Results do not establish added value beyond a vintage macroeconomic model. No LOC, old crisis-window exports, or modern extension claims enter.
